chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Daylamī, from his father, from Abān ibn Taghlib, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “May I be sacrificed for you.”
His saying: “But he did not attempt the steep ascent.”
So he عليه السلام said: “Whoever Allah has honored with our wilayah has indeed crossed the steep ascent, and we are that steep ascent which whoever undertakes it is saved.”
He said: Then he was silent, then he said to me, “Shall I give you a statement that is better for you than the world and whatever is in it?” I said, “Yes, may I be sacrificed for you.”
He said: His saying: “The freeing of a neck.”
Then he said: “All the people are slaves of the Fire except you and your companions, for Allah has freed your necks from the Fire through our wilayah, the Ahl al-Bayt.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household; the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعَقَبَةَ: the steep ascent; interpreted here as the salvific path linked to wilayah
key_terms.بِوَلَايَتِنَا: through our wilayah; through allegiance and devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.عَبِيدُ النَّارِ: slaves of the Fire; those bound for punishment
key_terms.فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ: freeing a neck; interpreted here as deliverance from the Fire

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explain “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” and “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” in relation to the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an Imam-based tafsir of the verses about the steep ascent and freeing a slave, interpreting them through the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It teaches that acceptance of their wilayah is the path of salvation and deliverance from the Fire. The report highlights the theological significance of wilayah in relation to Quranic meaning and the afterlife.
